sentences.en: The old kettle [[rattled]] on the stove all morning.
sentences.cs: Stará konvice celé dopoledne [[rachotila]] na sporáku.

sentences.en: Somewhere down the hall a pipe [[rattled]] again.
sentences.cs: Někde dole na chodbě zase [[rachotila]] trubka.

sentences.en: Nobody noticed that the radio [[rattled]] quietly.
sentences.cs: Nikdo si nevšiml, že rádio tiše [[rachotila]].

words.hint: A baby's toy makes this sound.
words.note: rattle = short, hard knocks; rustle = soft, papery.
